source.text: וָאֹמַ֗ר שִׁמְעוּ־נָא֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּקְצִינֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲל֣וֹא לָכֶ֔ם לָדַ֖עַת אֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: And I said: Hear, please, heads of Jacob and rulers of [the] house of Israel; [is it] not for you to know justice?

en.L: And I said: Hear, please, you heads of Jacob \q and you rulers of the house of Israel! \q Is it not yours to know justice?
en.B: And I said: Listen, you leaders of Jacob, \q you rulers of Israel's house! \q Should you not know what justice is?
en.R: Then I said: Listen, you leaders of the people of Jacob, \q you rulers of Israel! \q You are the ones who should know what is just.

vi.L: Tôi đã nói: Xin hãy nghe, hỡi các người đứng đầu Gia-cốp \q và các người cai trị nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên! \q Chẳng phải các người là người phải biết công lý sao?
vi.B: Tôi đã nói: Hãy lắng nghe, hỡi các nhà lãnh đạo của Gia-cốp, \q hỡi các người cai trị nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên! \q Chẳng lẽ các người không biết công lý là gì sao?
vi.R: Bấy giờ tôi nói: Hãy lắng nghe, hỡi các nhà lãnh đạo của dân Gia-cốp, \q hỡi các người cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên! \q Chính các người là những người phải biết điều gì là công bằng.

fr.L: Et j’ai dit : Écoutez donc, chefs de Jacob \q et magistrats de la maison d’Israël ! \q N’est-ce pas à vous de connaître le droit ?
fr.B: Alors j’ai dit : Écoutez, chefs de Jacob, \q dirigeants de la maison d’Israël ! \q N’est-ce pas à vous de savoir ce qu’est la justice ?
fr.R: Alors j’ai dit : Écoutez, chefs du peuple de Jacob, \q dirigeants d’Israël ! \q C’est vous qui devriez savoir ce qui est juste.

es.L: Y dije: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} ahora, cabezas de Jacob \q y gobernantes de la casa de Israel: \q ¿No {{plural_you:les|os}} corresponde a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} conocer el derecho?
es.B: Y dije: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}, jefes de Jacob, \q gobernantes de la casa de Israel: \q ¿No {{plural_you:deberían ustedes|deberíais vosotros}} conocer el derecho?
es.R: Entonces dije: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}, dirigentes del pueblo de Jacob, \q gobernantes de Israel. \q {{plural_you:Ustedes son los que deberían|Vosotros sois los que deberíais}} saber lo que es justo.

sw.L: Nami nikasema: Sikieni, tafadhali, enyi vichwa vya Yakobo \q na ninyi watawala wa nyumba ya Israeli! \q Je, si juu yenu kujua haki?
sw.B: Nami nikasema: Sikilizeni, enyi viongozi wa Yakobo, \q enyi watawala wa nyumba ya Israeli! \q Je, ninyi hampaswi kujua haki ni nini?
sw.R: Kisha nikasema: Sikilizeni, enyi viongozi wa watu wa Yakobo, \q enyi watawala wa Israeli! \q Ninyi ndio mnaopaswa kujua lililo haki.

decisions.choice: And I said: the prophet speaks in his own voice, beginning a new section
decisions.reason: Chapters 1 and 2 moved between the LORD's words and the prophet's. Here Micah speaks as "I" and turns to the leaders, whom he addresses again in verse 9. Chapter 3 is three oracles: against the rulers (1-4), the prophets (5-8), and all the leaders together (9-12).

decisions.choice: heads ... rulers: the leading men who governed and judged
decisions.reason: "Heads" are the chiefs of the people (Exodus 18:25); "rulers" are leaders or commanders (Isaiah 1:10; 3:6-7). Both groups judged cases, which is why justice is their business. "Jacob" and "the house of Israel" here mean the people as a whole, now ruled from Jerusalem (verse 10).

decisions.choice: to know justice: to understand it and to do it
decisions.reason: To "know" in the Bible is more than to have information: it is to recognize and act on what one knows (Jeremiah 22:15-16). The leaders' task was to see that what is right was done, above all for the weak (Isaiah 1:17). Justice is a key word of Micah (3:8, 9; 6:8).

decisions.choice: Hear, please (L); Listen (B, R); heads (L); leaders (B, R); rulers (all levels)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the polite "please" that the Hebrew adds; in English it reads as an urgent request. Balanced and Readable say "leaders" for "heads". The prophet's own words take no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: mishpat "le droit" (L), "la justice" (B), "ce qui est juste" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for justice and righteousness in the Twelve; Balanced says "la justice" here because the word stands alone.

decisions.choice: Micah, rebuking the leaders in his own voice, says "tôi" and "các người" (3:1-3, 9-12); where the LORD speaks (3:5-7) it is "các ngươi"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the prophet speaks in his own voice here. The Isaiah and Jeremiah note gives the prophet "các người" in rebuke, and keeps "các ngươi" for God's own speech.

decisions.choice: "công lý" for "mishpat"
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for "mishpat" in the Twelve, used through Micah (3:8, 9; 6:8; 7:9).

decisions.choice: "cabezas" (L); "jefes" (B); "dirigentes" (R); "gobernantes" (all levels)
decisions.reason: The same words are kept for the leaders in 3:1, 9 and 11, so the repeated summons can be seen.

decisions.choice: "el derecho" (L, B); "lo que es justo" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Spanish for mishpat in the prophets (term sheet).

decisions.choice: "vichwa" (L); "viongozi" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of "heads"; Balanced and Readable say leaders, as the English does. The same in 3:9 and 3:11.

source.text: שֹׂ֥נְאֵי ט֖וֹב וְאֹ֣הֲבֵי רָ֑ע גֹּזְלֵ֤י עוֹרָם֙ מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וּשְׁאֵרָ֖ם מֵעַ֥ל עַצְמוֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Haters of good and lovers of evil, tearing off their skin from on them and their flesh from on their bones,

en.L: You who hate good and love evil, \q who tear off their skin from upon them \q and their flesh from upon their bones,
en.B: You who hate good and love evil, \q who tear the skin off my people \q and the flesh off their bones,
en.R: But you hate what is good and love what is evil. \q You are like butchers who skin my people \q and tear the flesh off their bones.

vi.L: Các người ghét điều thiện và yêu điều ác, \q lột da khỏi mình chúng \q và róc thịt khỏi xương chúng,
vi.B: Các người ghét điều lành và yêu điều dữ, \q lột da dân tôi \q và róc thịt khỏi xương họ,
vi.R: Nhưng các người lại ghét điều tốt và yêu điều ác. \q Các người như những kẻ đồ tể lột da dân tôi \q và xé thịt khỏi xương họ.

fr.L: Vous qui haïssez le bien et aimez le mal, \q qui leur arrachez la peau de dessus eux \q et la chair de dessus leurs os,
fr.B: vous qui haïssez le bien et aimez le mal, \q qui arrachez la peau de mon peuple \q et la chair de ses os,
fr.R: Mais vous, vous détestez le bien et vous aimez le mal. \q Vous êtes comme des bouchers qui écorchent mon peuple \q et arrachent la chair de ses os.

es.L: aborrecedores del bien y amantes del mal, \q que {{plural_you:arrancan|arrancáis}} su piel de encima de ellos \q y su carne de sobre sus huesos,
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes, que odian el bien y aman|Vosotros, que odiáis el bien y amáis}} el mal, \q que le {{plural_you:arrancan|arrancáis}} la piel a mi pueblo \q y la carne de los huesos,
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes odian|vosotros odiáis}} lo bueno y {{plural_you:aman|amáis}} lo malo. \q {{plural_you:Son|Sois}} como carniceros que le quitan la piel a mi pueblo \q y le arrancan la carne de los huesos.

sw.L: Ninyi mnaochukia mema na kupenda mabaya, \q mnaowachuna ngozi yao juu yao \q na nyama yao juu ya mifupa yao,
sw.B: Ninyi mnaochukia mema na kupenda mabaya, \q mnaowachuna watu wangu ngozi \q na kuibandua nyama kutoka mifupa yao,
sw.R: Lakini ninyi mnachukia yaliyo mema na kupenda yaliyo maovu. \q Mko kama wachinjaji wanaowachuna watu wangu ngozi \q na kuibandua nyama kutoka mifupa yao.

decisions.choice: hate good and love evil: the reverse of what Amos commands
decisions.reason: Amos had said, "Hate evil, and love good, and establish justice in the gate" (Amos 5:15; compare Isaiah 5:20). The leaders who should know justice (verse 1) do the opposite.

decisions.choice: tear off their skin ... their flesh from their bones: the leaders treat the people like animals for slaughter
decisions.reason: The picture is of a butcher skinning and cutting up a carcass, carried on into cooking in verse 3. It is a figure, not a report of actual violence: by bribery, unjust judgments and seizing land (2:1-2), the leaders live off the people as if eating them. Psalm 14:4 speaks of evildoers "who eat up my people as they eat bread".

decisions.choice: their skin: the skin of the people, named in the next verse
decisions.reason: "Their" looks ahead to "my people" in verse 3; the sentence runs on from verse 1 through verse 3.

decisions.choice: the skin off my people (B); like butchers who skin my people (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name "my people" here, from verse 3, so that "their" is clear. Readable says plainly that the picture is a likeness (m2) and makes the sentence that runs on in the Hebrew into shorter ones.

decisions.choice: "aborrecedores del bien y amantes del mal" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew nouns made from verbs ("haters", "lovers") in apposition to the leaders addressed in verse 1.

source.text: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר אָכְלוּ֮ שְׁאֵ֣ר עַמִּי֒ וְעוֹרָם֙ מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֣ם הִפְשִׁ֔יטוּ וְאֶת־עַצְמֹֽתֵיהֶ֖ם פִּצֵּ֑חוּ וּפָרְשׂוּ֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּסִּ֔יר וּכְבָשָׂ֖ר בְּת֥וֹךְ קַלָּֽחַת׃

records.literal_gloss: and who have eaten [the] flesh of my people, and their skin from on them they have stripped, and their bones they have broken, and they have chopped [them] up as in the pot, and like flesh in [the] midst of a cauldron.

en.L: and who eat the flesh of my people, \q and strip their skin from upon them, \q and break their bones, \q and chop [them] up as in the pot, \q and like meat in the middle of a cauldron.
en.B: who eat the flesh of my people, \q strip off their skin, \q break their bones, \q and chop them up like meat for the pot, \q like flesh in a cooking kettle.
en.R: You eat my people's flesh. \q You strip off their skin \q and break their bones. \q You chop them up like meat for the pot, \q like stew meat in a kettle.

vi.L: các người ăn thịt dân tôi, \q lột da khỏi mình họ, \q bẻ gãy xương họ, \q và chặt [họ] ra như trong nồi, \q như thịt giữa vạc.
vi.B: ăn thịt dân tôi, \q lột da họ, \q bẻ gãy xương họ, \q và chặt họ ra như thịt bỏ vào nồi, \q như thịt trong chảo nấu.
vi.R: Các người ăn thịt dân tôi. \q Các người lột da họ \q và bẻ gãy xương họ. \q Các người chặt họ ra như thịt để nấu, \q như thịt hầm trong nồi.

fr.L: et qui mangez la chair de mon peuple, \q et leur arrachez la peau de dessus eux, \q et leur brisez les os, \q et [les] découpez comme dans la marmite, \q et comme de la viande au milieu d’un chaudron.
fr.B: qui mangez la chair de mon peuple, \q qui lui arrachez la peau, \q qui lui brisez les os \q et le découpez comme de la viande pour la marmite, \q comme de la chair dans un chaudron.
fr.R: Vous mangez la chair de mon peuple. \q Vous lui arrachez la peau \q et vous lui brisez les os. \q Vous le découpez comme de la viande pour la marmite, \q comme des morceaux dans un chaudron.

es.L: y que {{plural_you:comen|coméis}} la carne de mi pueblo, \q y les {{plural_you:arrancan|arrancáis}} la piel de encima, \q y les {{plural_you:quiebran|quebráis}} los huesos, \q y [los] {{plural_you:despedazan|despedazáis}} como en la olla, \q y como carne en medio del caldero.
es.B: que {{plural_you:comen|coméis}} la carne de mi pueblo, \q le {{plural_you:arrancan|arrancáis}} la piel, \q le {{plural_you:rompen|rompéis}} los huesos \q y lo {{plural_you:despedazan|despedazáis}} como carne para la olla, \q como carne en una marmita.
es.R: {{plural_you:Se comen|Os coméis}} la carne de mi pueblo. \q Le {{plural_you:quitan|quitáis}} la piel \q y le {{plural_you:rompen|rompéis}} los huesos. \q Lo {{plural_you:cortan|cortáis}} en pedazos como carne para la olla, \q como carne para guisar en una cazuela.

sw.L: na mnaokula nyama ya watu wangu, \q na kuichuna ngozi yao juu yao, \q na kuivunja mifupa yao, \q na kuwakatakata kama katika chungu, \q na kama nyama katikati ya sufuria.
sw.B: mnaokula nyama ya watu wangu, \q mnaowachuna ngozi, \q mnaoivunja mifupa yao, \q na kuwakatakata kama nyama ya chunguni, \q kama nyama katika sufuria ya kupikia.
sw.R: Mnakula nyama ya watu wangu. \q Mnawachuna ngozi \q na kuivunja mifupa yao. \q Mnawakatakata kama nyama ya chunguni, \q kama nyama ya mchuzi katika sufuria.

decisions.choice: eat ... strip ... break ... chop up: the picture of the butcher finished in the cooking pot
decisions.reason: The figure of verse 2 is carried to its end: the people are skinned, broken and boiled. The leaders consume the people they were meant to protect. Ezekiel 11:3-11 and 24:3-12 use the cooking pot as a picture of Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: as in the pot: as the Hebrew text has it
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "as" (literally "as which") before "in the pot". The ancient Greek translation reads "like flesh", which comes from almost the same Hebrew letters and matches "like meat" in the next line. The sense is the same either way.

decisions.choice: my people: the prophet's people, whom the LORD also calls his
decisions.reason: Micah speaks (verse 1), and he calls the oppressed "my people", as in 1:9. He speaks for the LORD, who uses the same words in 2:8-9 and 3:5.

decisions.choice: as in the pot (L); like meat for the pot (B, R); cauldron (L); cooking kettle (B); kettle (R)
decisions.reason: The two words for cooking vessels are a pot and a larger pot or cauldron. Balanced and Readable join the two lines' likenesses into one picture of meat for cooking.

decisions.choice: "dân tôi" for "my people" in Micah's own speech
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the prophet's people, whom the LORD also calls his; in Micah's own voice it is "tôi", lowercase, with no span. The English has no deity span here either.

decisions.choice: "watu wangu" with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Here the prophet speaks of his own people (meaning decision), so "wangu" is Micah's and takes no span, as the English "my" has none in 3:2-3.

source.text: אָ֚ז יִזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲנֶ֖ה אוֹתָ֑ם וְיַסְתֵּ֨ר פָּנָ֤יו מֵהֶם֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵרֵ֖עוּ מַעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Then they will cry out to Yahweh, and not he will answer them; and he will hide his face from them at that time, as they have made evil their deeds.

en.L: Then they will cry out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not answer them; \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will hide {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face from them at that time, \q as they have made their deeds evil.
en.B: Then they will call to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give them no answer. \q When that time comes {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will hide {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face from them, \q for their deeds have been evil.
en.R: Someday these leaders will cry out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not answer them. \q At that time {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will turn away from them, \q because they have done such evil things.

vi.L: Bấy giờ chúng sẽ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không đáp lời chúng; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ẩn mặt khỏi chúng trong lúc ấy, \q vì chúng đã làm những việc ác.
vi.B: Bấy giờ chúng sẽ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không đáp lời chúng. \q Khi thời ấy đến, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ẩn mặt khỏi chúng, \q vì việc làm của chúng thật gian ác.
vi.R: Một ngày kia, những kẻ lãnh đạo này sẽ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không trả lời chúng. \q Lúc ấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ quay mặt khỏi chúng, \q vì chúng đã làm những việc quá gian ác.

fr.L: Alors ils crieront vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne leur répondra pas ; \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur cachera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face en ce temps-là, \q selon qu’ils ont rendu mauvaises leurs actions.
fr.B: Alors ils appelleront {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au secours, \q mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne leur répondra pas. \q En ce temps-là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur cachera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face, \q car leurs actions ont été mauvaises.
fr.R: Un jour, ces chefs crieront {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les aide, \q mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne leur répondra pas. \q À ce moment-là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se détournera d’eux, \q parce qu’ils ont fait tant de mal.

es.L: Entonces clamarán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no les responderá; \q y esconderá de ellos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro en aquel tiempo, \q por cuanto hicieron malas sus obras.
es.B: Entonces clamarán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} pidiendo ayuda, \q pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no les dará respuesta. \q Cuando llegue ese tiempo, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les esconderá {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro, \q porque sus obras han sido malas.
es.R: Algún día estos dirigentes clamarán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} pidiendo ayuda, \q pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no les responderá. \q En ese tiempo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se apartará de ellos, \q porque han hecho cosas muy malas.

sw.L: Ndipo watamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} hatawajibu; \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atawaficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wakati huo, \q kwa kuwa wamefanya matendo yao kuwa mabaya.
sw.B: Ndipo watamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awasaidie, \q lakini hatawajibu. \q Wakati huo utakapofika atawaficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q kwa maana matendo yao yamekuwa maovu.
sw.R: Siku moja viongozi hawa watamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awasaidie, \q lakini hatawajibu. \q Wakati huo atawageuzia mgongo, \q kwa sababu wametenda mambo maovu kiasi hicho.

decisions.choice: they will cry out, but he will not answer: the measure they gave is the measure they get
decisions.reason: When disaster comes, the leaders will cry to the LORD as the oppressed cried to them, and get the answer they gave. Proverbs 21:13 says that whoever shuts his ears to the cry of the poor will himself cry out and not be answered. Isaiah 1:15 says the same of prayers raised by hands full of blood.

decisions.choice: hide his face: withdraw his favor and help
decisions.reason: To see someone's face is to be accepted by him; when God "hides his face", he turns away and leaves people to the trouble they have brought on themselves (Deuteronomy 31:17-18; Isaiah 59:2).

decisions.choice: Someday these leaders ... for help; turn away from them (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names who will cry out and why, and says what hiding the face means (m2).

source.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים הַמַּתְעִ֣ים אֶת־עַמִּ֑י הַנֹּשְׁכִ֤ים בְּשִׁנֵּיהֶם֙ וְקָרְא֣וּ שָׁל֔וֹם וַאֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא־יִתֵּ֣ן עַל־פִּיהֶ֔ם וְקִדְּשׁ֥וּ עָלָ֖יו מִלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh concerning the prophets who lead astray my people, who bite with their teeth and proclaim peace, and whoever does not put on their mouth, they consecrate against him war.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q concerning the prophets who lead {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people astray, \q who bite with their teeth and proclaim, "Peace!" \q but whoever does not put [food] into their mouths, \q against him they consecrate war.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this \q about the prophets who lead {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people astray, \q who cry, "Peace!" when they have something to bite with their teeth, \q but against anyone who puts nothing into their mouths \q they declare a holy war.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says \q about the prophets who lead {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people the wrong way: \q When people feed them, they promise peace. \q But if anyone does not feed them, \q they announce war against that person.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này \q về các tiên tri làm cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lầm lạc, \q là những kẻ có gì cắn bằng răng thì rao: "Bình an!" \q nhưng ai không bỏ [thức ăn] vào miệng chúng, \q thì chúng khai chiến nghịch cùng người ấy.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy \q về các tiên tri làm cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lầm lạc, \q là những kẻ hễ có gì để nhai thì hô: "Bình an!" \q nhưng ai không cho gì vào miệng chúng, \q thì chúng tuyên bố thánh chiến với người ấy.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán \q về các tiên tri dẫn dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đi sai đường: \q Khi được người ta cho ăn, chúng hứa hẹn bình an. \q Nhưng nếu ai không cho chúng ăn, \q chúng liền tuyên chiến với người ấy.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} \q au sujet des prophètes qui égarent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, \q qui mordent avec leurs dents et proclament : « Paix ! » \q mais quiconque ne met rien dans leur bouche, \q contre lui ils sanctifient la guerre.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci \q au sujet des prophètes qui égarent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, \q qui crient : « Paix ! » quand ils ont quelque chose à mordre, \q mais qui, contre celui qui ne leur met rien dans la bouche, \q déclarent une guerre sainte.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} \q au sujet des prophètes qui mènent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple sur un mauvais chemin : \q Quand on les nourrit, ils promettent la paix. \q Mais si quelqu’un ne les nourrit pas, \q ils lui annoncent la guerre.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} \q acerca de los profetas que hacen errar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, \q que muerden con sus dientes y proclaman: «¡Paz!», \q pero al que no les pone [algo] en la boca, \q contra él consagran la guerra.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto \q acerca de los profetas que extravían a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, \q que gritan «¡Paz!» cuando tienen algo que morder con los dientes, \q pero contra el que no les pone nada en la boca \q declaran una guerra santa.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} \q acerca de los profetas que llevan a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo por mal camino: \q Cuando la gente les da de comer, prometen paz. \q Pero si alguien no les da de comer, \q le declaran la guerra.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi \q kuhusu manabii wanaowapotosha watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q wanaouma kwa meno yao na kutangaza, "Amani!" \q lakini mtu yeyote asiyetia [chakula] vinywani mwao, \q juu yake wanatakasa vita.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo \q kuhusu manabii wanaowapotosha watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q wanaopiga kelele, "Amani!" wanapokuwa na kitu cha kutafuna kwa meno yao, \q lakini mtu yeyote asiyewatilia kitu vinywani mwao \q wanamtangazia vita vitakatifu.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema \q kuhusu manabii wanaowaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} njia mbaya: \q Watu wanapowalisha, wanaahidi amani. \q Lakini mtu yeyote asipowalisha, \q wanatangaza vita dhidi ya mtu huyo.

decisions.choice: who bite with their teeth and proclaim peace: they promise good when they are fed
alternatives: who bite like snakes while they proclaim peace
decisions.reason: Prophets were often given food or a gift by those who asked them for a word (1 Samuel 9:7-8; 1 Kings 14:3). These prophets shape their message to the pay: those who feed them hear "peace"; those who do not are their enemies. The verb "bite" is often used of snakes, and some take it as a picture of their venom, but the contrast with "puts nothing into their mouths" points to eating.

decisions.choice: they consecrate war against him: they declare a holy war
decisions.reason: To "consecrate" a war was to begin it with the rites that set it apart for God (Jeremiah 6:4; Joel 4:9). The prophets speak of their quarrels with the man who will not pay as if it were the LORD's battle.

decisions.choice: who lead my people astray: they make the people go the wrong way
decisions.reason: The verb means to cause to wander off the path. Isaiah 3:12 and 9:15 use it of leaders and prophets who mislead. "My people" is the LORD speaking.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD (L); The LORD says this (B); This is what the LORD says (R); Peace (L, B); they promise peace (R); declare a holy war (B)
decisions.reason: The formula follows the wording set for the prophets; here it introduces the subject of the oracle, and the LORD's words begin in verse 6. Readable gives the meaning of the bite and the mouth (m1). Balanced says "declare a holy war" for "consecrate war" (m2).

decisions.choice: "khai chiến" (L); "tuyên bố thánh chiến" (B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: they consecrate war, declaring a holy war; "khai chiến" at Literal keeps the act of opening war, and Balanced names it as holy.

decisions.choice: "consagran la guerra" (L); "declaran una guerra santa" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew verb "consecrate"; Balanced says what it means, a war declared in God's name.

decisions.choice: "BWANA asema hivi" (L); "Hivi ndivyo BWANA asemavyo" (B); "Hili ndilo BWANA analosema" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula as in 2:3, here without "Kwa hiyo" and with no colon because the sentence runs on into its subject.

source.text: לָכֵ֞ן לַ֤יְלָה לָכֶם֙ מֵֽחָז֔וֹן וְחָשְׁכָ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם מִקְּסֹ֑ם וּבָ֤אָה הַשֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ עַל־הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְקָדַ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore night [will be] to you without vision, and it will be dark to you without divining; and will go down the sun on the prophets, and will be dark over them the day.

en.L: Therefore [it will be] night for you, without vision, \q and darkness for you, without divination; \q and the sun will set over the prophets, \q and the day will grow dark over them.
en.B: Therefore night will come on you, with no vision, \q and darkness, with no divination. \q The sun will set on the prophets, \q and the day will turn black over them.
en.R: So night will fall on you prophets, and you will see no visions. \q Darkness will cover you, and you will not be able to tell the future. \q The sun will go down on these prophets, \q and their day will turn dark.

vi.L: Vì vậy [sẽ là] đêm tối cho các ngươi, không có khải tượng, \q và bóng tối cho các ngươi, không có bói toán; \q mặt trời sẽ lặn trên các tiên tri, \q và ban ngày sẽ tối sầm trên chúng.
vi.B: Vì thế đêm tối sẽ phủ trên các ngươi, không còn khải tượng, \q và bóng tối, không còn bói toán. \q Mặt trời sẽ lặn trên các tiên tri, \q và ban ngày sẽ tối đen trên chúng.
vi.R: Vì vậy, hỡi các tiên tri, đêm tối sẽ phủ xuống các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ không thấy khải tượng nào. \q Bóng tối sẽ bao phủ các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ không thể đoán biết tương lai. \q Mặt trời sẽ lặn trên các tiên tri này, \q và ngày của chúng sẽ trở nên tối tăm.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi [ce sera] pour vous la nuit, sans vision, \q et les ténèbres pour vous, sans divination ; \q et le soleil se couchera sur les prophètes, \q et le jour s’assombrira sur eux.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi la nuit viendra sur vous, sans vision, \q et l’obscurité, sans divination. \q Le soleil se couchera sur les prophètes, \q et le jour deviendra noir au-dessus d’eux.
fr.R: Alors la nuit tombera sur vous, les prophètes, et vous n’aurez plus de visions. \q L’obscurité vous recouvrira, et vous ne pourrez plus annoncer l’avenir. \q Le soleil se couchera sur ces prophètes, \q et leur jour deviendra sombre.

es.L: Por tanto, [será] noche para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, sin visión, \q y oscuridad para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, sin adivinación; \q y se pondrá el sol sobre los profetas, \q y el día se oscurecerá sobre ellos.
es.B: Por eso la noche caerá sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, sin visión, \q y la oscuridad, sin adivinación. \q El sol se pondrá sobre los profetas, \q y el día se volverá negro sobre ellos.
es.R: Por eso la noche caerá sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, profetas, y no {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} visiones. \q La oscuridad {{plural_you:los|os}} cubrirá, y no {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} predecir el futuro. \q El sol se pondrá sobre estos profetas, \q y su día se volverá oscuro.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo [kutakuwa] usiku kwenu, bila maono, \q na giza kwenu, bila uaguzi; \q na jua litazama juu ya manabii, \q na mchana utakuwa giza juu yao.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo usiku utawajia, bila maono, \q na giza, bila uaguzi. \q Jua litawatua manabii, \q na mchana utakuwa mweusi juu yao.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo usiku utawaangukia ninyi manabii, wala hamtaona maono. \q Giza litawafunika, wala hamtaweza kutabiri yatakayotokea. \q Jua litatua juu ya manabii hawa, \q na mchana wao utakuwa giza.

decisions.choice: night ... darkness ... the sun will go down: the prophets will receive no more revelation
decisions.reason: Night and darkness are pictures of being cut off from God's word, and also of disaster (Amos 5:18; 8:9). Those who promised peace for pay will have nothing to say when the disaster comes, because the LORD will not answer them (verse 7).

decisions.choice: divination: seeking signs of the future, a practice the law forbids
decisions.reason: The law forbids divination as a practice of the nations (Deuteronomy 18:10-14), and Balaam the diviner is its type (Joshua 13:22). Micah uses the word of these prophets to say that they are no better than diviners: their words come for a fee, not from the LORD (verse 11).

decisions.choice: you prophets; you will not be able to tell the future (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names those addressed and says what divination is (m2).

source.text: וּבֹ֣שׁוּהַחֹזִ֗ים וְחָֽפְרוּ֙ הַקֹּ֣סְמִ֔ים וְעָט֥וּ עַל־שָׂפָ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑ם כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין מַעֲנֵ֖ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be ashamed the seers, and will be abashed the diviners, and they will cover over [the] mustache, all of them, for there is no answer of God.

en.L: And the seers will be ashamed, and the diviners abashed, \q and they will all cover [their] mustaches, \q for there is no answer from God.
en.B: The seers will be put to shame and the diviners disgraced; \q they will all cover their faces, \q because there is no answer from God.
en.R: These prophets will be ashamed and disgraced. \q They will all cover their mouths in shame, \q because God will not answer them.

vi.L: Các nhà tiên kiến sẽ xấu hổ, các thầy bói sẽ bẽ mặt, \q và hết thảy chúng sẽ che [râu] mép, \q vì không có lời đáp nào từ Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Các nhà tiên kiến sẽ bị hổ thẹn, các thầy bói sẽ bị nhục nhã; \q hết thảy chúng sẽ che mặt lại, \q vì Đức Chúa Trời không đáp lời.
vi.R: Các tiên tri này sẽ xấu hổ và nhục nhã. \q Hết thảy chúng sẽ lấy tay che miệng vì hổ thẹn, \q vì Đức Chúa Trời sẽ không trả lời chúng.

fr.L: Et les voyants seront honteux, et les devins confondus, \q et ils se couvriront tous la moustache, \q car il n’y a pas de réponse de Dieu.
fr.B: Les voyants seront couverts de honte et les devins déshonorés ; \q ils se couvriront tous le visage, \q car il n’y a pas de réponse de Dieu.
fr.R: Ces prophètes seront couverts de honte. \q Ils se cacheront tous la bouche, honteux, \q parce que Dieu ne leur répondra pas.

es.L: Y se avergonzarán los videntes, y se abochornarán los adivinos, \q y se cubrirán todos ellos el bigote, \q porque no hay respuesta de Dios.
es.B: Los videntes quedarán en vergüenza y los adivinos, humillados; \q todos se taparán la cara, \q porque no hay respuesta de Dios.
es.R: Estos profetas quedarán avergonzados y humillados. \q Todos se taparán la boca de vergüenza, \q porque Dios no les responderá.

sw.L: Na waonaji wataaibika, na waaguzi watafedheheka, \q nao wote watafunika masharubu [yao], \q kwa maana hakuna jibu kutoka kwa Mungu.
sw.B: Waonaji wataaibishwa na waaguzi watafedheheka; \q wote watafunika nyuso zao, \q kwa sababu hakuna jibu kutoka kwa Mungu.
sw.R: Manabii hawa wataaibika na kufedheheka. \q Wote watafunika vinywa vyao kwa aibu, \q kwa sababu Mungu hatawajibu.

decisions.choice: cover the mustache: cover the lower face in shame or mourning
decisions.reason: To cover the upper lip and mustache was a sign of mourning or disgrace, as the leper did and the mourner (Leviticus 13:45; Ezekiel 24:17, 22). The prophets who opened their mouths so freely will cover them, with nothing to say.

decisions.choice: seers ... diviners: the prophets, called by an old name and a scornful one
decisions.reason: "Seer" is an old word for a prophet (1 Samuel 9:9); "diviner" is the word for the forbidden practice of verse 6. Micah sets the two side by side: these seers are diviners.

decisions.choice: seers ... diviners (L, B); These prophets (R); [their] mustaches (L); their faces (B); their mouths (R)
decisions.reason: Readable calls both groups prophets, as they are (m2). Balanced and Readable say what is covered in plainer words than "mustache".

decisions.choice: "che [râu] mép" (L); "che mặt" (B); "che miệng" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: covering the lower face in shame or mourning. Vietnamese "mép" is the corner of the mouth, so Literal brackets "râu" to keep the Hebrew "mustache".

source.text: וְאוּלָ֗ם אָנֹכִ֞י מָלֵ֤אתִי כֹ֨חַ֙ אֶת־ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּגְבוּרָ֑ה לְהַגִּ֤יד לְיַֽעֲקֹב֙ פִּשְׁע֔וֹ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חַטָּאתֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: But as for me, I am full of power, with the Spirit of Yahweh, and justice and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.

en.L: But as for me, I am filled with power, with the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and with justice and might, \q to declare to Jacob his transgression \q and to Israel his sin.
en.B: But I am filled with power, with the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q with justice and strength, \q to tell Jacob of his rebellion \q and Israel of his sin.
en.R: But the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has filled me with power. \q He has given me a sense of what is right and the courage to speak, \q so that I can tell the people of Jacob how they have rebelled \q and the people of Israel how they have sinned.

vi.L: Còn tôi, tôi được đầy dẫy quyền năng, bởi Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q cùng công lý và sức mạnh, \q để rao cho Gia-cốp tội vi phạm của nó \q và cho Y-sơ-ra-ên tội lỗi của nó.
vi.B: Nhưng tôi được đầy dẫy quyền năng, bởi Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q đầy công lý và sức mạnh, \q để nói cho Gia-cốp biết tội ác của nó \q và cho Y-sơ-ra-ên biết tội lỗi của nó.
vi.R: Nhưng Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho tôi đầy quyền năng. \q Ngài cho tôi biết điều gì là đúng và cho tôi can đảm để nói ra, \q để tôi nói cho dân Gia-cốp biết họ đã phản nghịch thế nào \q và cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên biết họ đã phạm tội ra sao.

fr.L: Mais moi, je suis rempli de force, de l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q et de droit et de vaillance, \q pour déclarer à Jacob sa transgression \q et à Israël son péché.
fr.B: Mais moi, je suis rempli de force, de l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q de justice et de courage, \q pour faire connaître à Jacob sa rébellion \q et à Israël son péché.
fr.R: Mais l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} m’a rempli de force. \q Il m’a donné le sens de ce qui est juste et le courage de parler, \q pour que je dise au peuple de Jacob comment il s’est révolté \q et au peuple d’Israël comment il a péché.

es.L: Pero yo estoy lleno de poder, con el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y de derecho y de fuerza, \q para declarar a Jacob su transgresión \q y a Israel su pecado.
es.B: Pero yo estoy lleno de poder, con el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q con justicia y con fuerza, \q para hacerle saber a Jacob su delito \q y a Israel su pecado.
es.R: Pero el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} me ha llenado de poder. \q Me ha dado sentido de lo que es justo y valor para hablar, \q para decirle al pueblo de Jacob cómo se ha rebelado \q y al pueblo de Israel cómo ha pecado.

sw.L: Lakini mimi, nimejazwa nguvu, pamoja na Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na haki na uweza, \q kumtangazia Yakobo maasi yake, \q na Israeli dhambi yake.
sw.B: Lakini mimi nimejazwa nguvu, pamoja na Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na haki na ujasiri, \q ili kumweleza Yakobo makosa yake, \q na Israeli dhambi yake.
sw.R: Lakini Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenijaza nguvu. \q Amenipa ufahamu wa lililo haki na ujasiri wa kusema, \q ili niwaambie watu wa Yakobo jinsi walivyoasi, \q na watu wa Israeli jinsi walivyotenda dhambi.

decisions.choice: filled with power, with the Spirit of the LORD: the true prophet speaks by the LORD's Spirit
decisions.reason: Micah sets himself against the prophets of verses 5-7. They speak for pay; he is filled by the Spirit of the LORD, who gave the prophets their message (Numbers 11:29; 2 Samuel 23:2; Isaiah 61:1). The word for "spirit" is the one the false preacher had only as "wind" (2:11).

decisions.choice: justice and might: a sense of what is right and the courage to say it
decisions.reason: "Justice" here is the right judgment the leaders lack (verse 1); "might" is strength or courage. Together they let Micah name the people's sin even when no one wants to hear it.

decisions.choice: with the Spirit of the LORD: the source of the power
decisions.reason: The small word before "Spirit" usually marks an object, and here means "with" or "by means of". The phrase stands between "power" and "justice and might" and names where they come from. Some think it was added to the line, since it breaks the list, but no Hebrew manuscript lacks it.

decisions.choice: transgression (L); rebellion (B); rebelled (R); declare to (L); tell (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word for transgression follows the wording set for the prophets. Readable makes the Spirit the one who acts (m1, m3), and turns the nouns into verbs.

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh của CHÚA"
decisions.reason: The terms note: the Spirit of God in the Old Testament is "Thần Linh", as Isaiah 61:1; "Đức Thánh Linh" stays the New Testament name.

decisions.choice: "justicia" (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "justicia" here, where "derecho" would not read naturally after "lleno de", for the sense of what is right that the prophet is given.

decisions.choice: "Roho wa BWANA", capitalised
decisions.reason: The LORD's Spirit is "Roho" with a capital at every level (term sheet); "Roho" for God's Spirit takes personal agreement ("amenijaza").

source.text: שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֣א זֹ֗את רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּקְצִינֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַֽמֲתַעֲבִ֣ים מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־הַיְשָׁרָ֖ה יְעַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear this, please, heads of [the] house of Jacob and rulers of [the] house of Israel, who loathe justice and everything straight make crooked,

en.L: Hear this, please, you heads of the house of Jacob \q and you rulers of the house of Israel, \q who loathe justice \q and make crooked everything that is straight,
en.B: Listen to this, you leaders of the house of Jacob, \q you rulers of the house of Israel, \q who hate justice \q and twist everything that is right,
en.R: Listen to this, you leaders of the people of Jacob, \q you rulers of Israel! \q You hate what is fair \q and twist everything that is right.

decisions.choice: Hear this, heads ... rulers: the call of verse 1 repeated for the last oracle
decisions.reason: The words repeat 3:1 almost exactly and begin the third oracle of the chapter, which gathers rulers, priests and prophets together (verse 11) and ends with the judgment on Jerusalem (verse 12).

decisions.choice: loathe justice and make crooked what is straight: they twist the law to their own ends
decisions.reason: The first verb is strong: to abhor, to find disgusting. "Straight" is what is upright and right; to make it crooked is to pervert justice (Isaiah 59:8; Amos 5:7). The sentence runs on into verse 10.

decisions.choice: heads (L); leaders (B, R); loathe (L); hate (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 1. Readable ends the sentence here; the Hebrew runs on into verse 10.

decisions.choice: build Zion with bloodshed: the city's buildings paid for by oppression
decisions.reason: Kings and nobles built fine houses and works in Jerusalem (Jeremiah 22:13-17 condemns a king for building with unpaid labor). Micah says the building was paid for with the lives and goods of the poor. Habakkuk 2:12 has almost the same line about a city built with bloodshed.

decisions.choice: bloodshed: killing, including deaths caused by unjust courts and greed
decisions.reason: The word is the plural of "blood", which means blood shed by violence and the guilt it brings. It covers more than murder: the poor ruined by the leaders' greed and the innocent condemned in their courts (1 Kings 21:13) count as blood shed.

decisions.choice: who build: a singular word for the leaders as a group
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is singular, "one who builds", used of each of the leaders of verse 9, or of the class as a whole; some think the king is meant. It continues the sentence of verse 9.

decisions.choice: with the blood of the people you kill (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what "bloodshed" means here (m2).

decisions.choice: "qui bâtit", singular, at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew participle is singular for the leaders as one body, as the English meaning decision notes; Literal keeps it, Balanced and Readable go back to the plural of the address.

records.literal_gloss: Her heads for a bribe judge, and her priests for a price teach, and her prophets for money divine; and on Yahweh they lean, saying, [Is] not Yahweh in our midst? Not will come upon us disaster.

en.L: Her heads judge for a bribe, and her priests teach for a price, \q and her prophets divine for money; \q yet they lean on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, saying, \q "Is not {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in our midst? \q Disaster will not come upon us."
en.B: Her leaders give judgment for a bribe, her priests teach for pay, \q and her prophets tell fortunes for money. \q Yet they lean on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and say, \q "Is not {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} among us? \q No disaster will come upon us."
en.R: Jerusalem's leaders take bribes to decide cases. Her priests teach only when they are paid, \q and her prophets tell the future only for money. \q And yet they rely on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and say, \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is with us! \q Nothing bad will happen to us."

vi.L: Các người đứng đầu của nó xét xử vì của hối lộ, các thầy tế lễ của nó dạy dỗ vì tiền công, \q và các tiên tri của nó bói toán vì tiền bạc; \q thế mà chúng lại nương cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và nói: \q "Chẳng phải {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở giữa chúng ta sao? \q Tai họa sẽ không đến trên chúng ta."

vi.R: Các nhà lãnh đạo của Giê-ru-sa-lem nhận hối lộ rồi mới xét xử. Các thầy tế lễ chỉ dạy khi được trả tiền, \q và các tiên tri chỉ đoán tương lai vì tiền. \q Thế mà chúng vẫn nương cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và nói: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với chúng ta! \q Chẳng có điều gì xấu xảy đến cho chúng ta đâu."

fr.L: Ses chefs jugent pour un pot-de-vin, et ses prêtres enseignent pour un salaire, \q et ses prophètes pratiquent la divination pour de l’argent ; \q et ils s’appuient sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en disant : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’[est-il] pas au milieu de nous ? \q Le malheur ne viendra pas sur nous. »
fr.B: Ses chefs rendent la justice pour un pot-de-vin, ses prêtres enseignent pour un salaire, \q et ses prophètes disent la bonne aventure pour de l’argent. \q Et pourtant ils s’appuient sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en disant : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’est-il pas au milieu de nous ? \q Aucun malheur ne viendra sur nous. »
fr.R: Les chefs de Jérusalem acceptent de l’argent pour juger les procès. Ses prêtres n’enseignent que si on les paie, \q et ses prophètes ne prédisent l’avenir que pour de l’argent. \q Et pourtant, ils comptent sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et ils disent : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est avec nous ! \q Rien de mal ne nous arrivera. »

es.L: Sus cabezas juzgan por soborno, y sus sacerdotes enseñan por precio, \q y sus profetas adivinan por dinero; \q y se apoyan en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, diciendo: \q «¿No está {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en medio de nosotros? \q No vendrá sobre nosotros el mal».
es.B: Sus jefes dictan sentencia por soborno, sus sacerdotes enseñan por paga \q y sus profetas adivinan por dinero. \q Y aun así se apoyan en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y dicen: \q «¿No está {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} entre nosotros? \q Ningún desastre vendrá sobre nosotros».
es.R: Los dirigentes de Jerusalén aceptan sobornos para decidir los casos. Sus sacerdotes enseñan solo cuando les pagan, \q y sus profetas predicen el futuro solo por dinero. \q Y aun así confían en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y dicen: \q «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está con nosotros! \q No nos pasará nada malo».

sw.L: Vichwa vyake vinahukumu kwa rushwa, na makuhani wake wanafundisha kwa ujira, \q na manabii wake wanabashiri kwa fedha; \q lakini wanamtegemea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakisema, \q "Je, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hayuko katikati yetu? \q Mabaya hayatatujia."
sw.B: Viongozi wake wanatoa hukumu kwa rushwa, makuhani wake wanafundisha kwa malipo, \q na manabii wake wanabashiri kwa fedha. \q Hata hivyo wanamtegemea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kusema, \q "Je, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hayuko pamoja nasi? \q Hakuna maafa yatakayotupata."
sw.R: Viongozi wa Yerusalemu wanapokea rushwa ili kuamua mashauri. Makuhani wake wanafundisha wakilipwa tu, \q na manabii wake wanatabiri yatakayotokea kwa ajili ya fedha tu. \q Lakini bado wanamtegemea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kusema, \q "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko pamoja nasi! \q Hakuna jambo baya litakalotupata."

decisions.choice: her heads ... her priests ... her prophets: every kind of leader in Jerusalem sells what should be freely given
decisions.reason: "Her" is Jerusalem (verse 10). The heads judged cases; the priests taught the law and gave rulings on it (Deuteronomy 17:9-11; 33:10; Malachi 2:7); the prophets gave the LORD's word. All three now do it for money, and the law forbids bribes in judgment (Exodus 23:8; Deuteronomy 16:19).

decisions.choice: Is not the LORD in our midst? Their confidence in the LORD's presence is false
decisions.reason: The LORD did dwell in Jerusalem in his temple (Psalm 46:6; 132:13-14), and the leaders think this guarantees their safety whatever they do. Jeremiah answers the same boast: "the temple of the LORD" will not save those who do wrong (Jeremiah 7:4-11). The next verse says that the temple hill itself will become a wilderness.

decisions.choice: divine: practice divination, Micah's scornful word for their prophesying
decisions.reason: As in verses 6-7, the prophets are called diviners: what they say comes from their fee, not from the LORD.

decisions.choice: heads (L); leaders (B, R); divine (L); tell fortunes (B); tell the future (R); The LORD is with us! (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names Jerusalem and turns the question "Is not the LORD in our midst?" into the statement it expects.

decisions.choice: "bói toán" (L, B); "đoán tương lai" (R) for the prophets' work
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: Micah's scornful word for their prophesying; Vietnamese keeps the scorn by calling it fortune-telling.

records.literal_gloss: Therefore on account of you Zion [as] a field will be plowed, and Jerusalem heaps of ruins will become, and [the] mountain of the house [will become] high places of a forest.

en.B: Therefore, because of you, \q Zion will be plowed as a field, \q Jerusalem will be a mound of ruins, \q and the mountain of the temple a wooded height.
en.R: So because of you, \q Zion will be plowed up like a field. \q Jerusalem will become a pile of ruins. \q The hill where the temple stands will be covered with trees and bushes.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, à cause de vous, \q Sion sera labourée [comme] un champ, \q et Jérusalem deviendra des monceaux de ruines, \q et la montagne de la maison, des hauteurs boisées.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi, à cause de vous, \q Sion sera labourée comme un champ, \q Jérusalem sera un tas de ruines, \q et la montagne du temple une hauteur couverte de bois.
fr.R: Alors, à cause de vous, \q Sion sera labourée comme un champ. \q Jérusalem deviendra un tas de ruines. \q La colline où se trouve le temple sera couverte d’arbres et de broussailles.

es.L: Por tanto, por causa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q Sion será arada [como] un campo, \q y Jerusalén se convertirá en montones de ruinas, \q y el monte de la casa [en] alturas de bosque.
es.B: Por eso, por causa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q Sion será arada como un campo, \q Jerusalén será un montón de ruinas, \q y el monte del templo, una colina cubierta de bosque.
es.R: Así que, por culpa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q Sion será arada como un campo. \q Jerusalén se convertirá en un montón de ruinas. \q La colina donde está el templo se cubrirá de árboles y matorrales.

sw.B: Kwa hiyo, kwa sababu yenu, \q Sayuni utalimwa kama shamba, \q Yerusalemu utakuwa rundo la magofu, \q na mlima wa hekalu utakuwa kilima cha msitu.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 26:18 quotes this verse
decisions.reason: About a hundred years later, when Jeremiah was on trial for foretelling the temple's ruin, elders of the land quoted these words: Micah had said the same in Hezekiah's days, and Hezekiah had sought the LORD's favor, so that the LORD held back the disaster (Jeremiah 26:17-19). The elders put "Thus says the LORD of hosts" before the saying; Micah begins "Therefore, because of you", and he spells the word for "heaps of ruins" with a different plural ending. Otherwise the words are the same.

decisions.choice: the mountain of the house will be high places of a forest: the temple hill will be left to grow wild
decisions.reason: "The mountain of the house" is the hill on which the temple stood (4:1). "High places" here means heights or ridges overgrown like wild country, not shrines. The leaders said the LORD's presence made them safe (verse 11); the place of his house will become a thicket. Jerusalem and the temple were destroyed by the Babylonians in 587 BC (2 Kings 25:8-10).

decisions.choice: because of you: the leaders' sins bring the city down
decisions.reason: "You" is plural: the heads, priests and prophets of verse 11. The city falls not because the LORD is weak but because of what its leaders have done.

decisions.choice: the wording of Jeremiah 26:18 at each level, with "Therefore, because of you" (L, B) and "So because of you" (R) added
decisions.reason: Each level reuses its wording of the published Jeremiah 26:18, where the elders quote this verse: "plowed [as] a field", "heaps of ruins" and "high places of a forest" at Literal; "a mound of ruins" and "a wooded height" at Balanced; "plowed up like a field" and "covered with trees and bushes" at Readable. Micah's own opening line is added, and the lines are set as Jeremiah sets them.

decisions.choice: The published Jeremiah 26:18 at each level, with "C'est pourquoi, à cause de vous" (L, B) and "Alors, à cause de vous" (R) added
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 26:18 quotes this verse; the Hebrew is the same, so French reuses the published wording, as the term sheet asks.

decisions.choice: the last three lines are the published Jeremiah 26:18 at each level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: Jeremiah 26:18 quotes this verse, and the Hebrew is the same; only "vì cớ các người" is added, as the English adds "because of you".

decisions.choice: the wording of Spanish Jeremiah 26:18 at each level, after "por causa de ustedes" (L, B) / "por culpa de ustedes" (R)
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 26:18 quotes this verse, so the Spanish reuses its published lines word for word.

decisions.choice: The published Swahili of Jeremiah 26:18 at each level, with "Kwa hiyo, kwa sababu yenu" added
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 26:18 quotes this verse, so its wording is reused (term sheet), and only Micah's opening words, which Jeremiah does not quote, are new.
